source.author: inkle Ltd.
source.compileSetup: Compile the entrypoint with its four local phase includes.

compiled.provenance: Generated locally from the deterministic derivative with official inklecate 1.2.1 count-all-visits enabled.

bugs.trigger: Choose the second, accidentally duplicated Wait option in the opening plan.
bugs.effect: The duplicate silently adds seven points of forcefulness before the interview.
bugs.description: Choose the second, accidentally duplicated Wait option in the opening plan. The duplicate silently adds seven points of forcefulness before the interview.

bugs.trigger: Take the first mug offered by Harris.
bugs.effect: Acquiring the teacup also creates the stolen Bombe component in inventory.
bugs.description: Take the first mug offered by Harris. Acquiring the teacup also creates the stolen Bombe component in inventory.

bugs.trigger: Reach Harris's first direct demand without being drugged.
bugs.effect: The direct Yes answer is hidden by an inverted availability condition.
bugs.description: Reach Harris's first direct demand without being drugged. The direct Yes answer is hidden by an inverted availability condition.

bugs.trigger: Deny knowing where the component is at Harris's first demand.
bugs.effect: The evasiveness score changes sign, reversing downstream personality gates.
bugs.description: Deny knowing where the component is at Harris's first demand. The evasiveness score changes sign, reversing downstream personality gates.

bugs.trigger: Evade Harris's first direct demand for the component.
bugs.effect: Merely evading marks the protagonist as drugged without drinking tea.
bugs.description: Evade Harris's first direct demand for the component. Merely evading marks the protagonist as drugged without drinking tea.

bugs.trigger: Take and drink the tea at Harris's demand.
bugs.effect: The cup flag is cleared immediately after drinking, contradicting the scene and later state.
bugs.description: Take and drink the tea at Harris's demand. The cup flag is cleared immediately after drinking, contradicting the scene and later state.

bugs.trigger: Admit being open to blackmail.
bugs.effect: A confession about blackmail also marks Hooper as already framed.
bugs.description: Admit being open to blackmail. A confession about blackmail also marks Hooper as already framed.

bugs.trigger: Choose Blame no-one when asked for a theory.
bugs.effect: The supposedly neutral answer records that Hooper was named.
bugs.description: Choose Blame no-one when asked for a theory. The supposedly neutral answer records that Hooper was named.

bugs.trigger: Lie after earlier admitting vulnerability to blackmail.
bugs.effect: The lie erases the earlier admission, altering later conditional dialogue.
bugs.description: Lie after earlier admitting vulnerability to blackmail. The lie erases the earlier admission, altering later conditional dialogue.

bugs.trigger: Dissemble while not drugged.
bugs.effect: The branch skips the Hooper accusation and jumps into the confession narrative.
bugs.description: Dissemble while not drugged. The branch skips the Hooper accusation and jumps into the confession narrative.

bugs.trigger: Reach the undrugged confession path and choose Lie.
bugs.effect: The truth-serum state turns back on even though no drug is present.
bugs.description: Reach the undrugged confession path and choose Lie. The truth-serum state turns back on even though no drug is present.

bugs.trigger: Claim not to have the component, then choose Lie.
bugs.effect: The denial creates the component in inventory while dialogue says it is gone.
bugs.description: Claim not to have the component, then choose Lie. The denial creates the component in inventory while dialogue says it is gone.

bugs.trigger: Accuse Hooper and choose the circumstantial Imply argument.
bugs.effect: Hooper is recorded as the revealed culprit before evidence or confession.
bugs.description: Accuse Hooper and choose the circumstantial Imply argument. Hooper is recorded as the revealed culprit before evidence or confession.

bugs.trigger: Threaten Hooper with the exact Hut 2 hiding place.
bugs.effect: The freshly stored straight clue is immediately overwritten with NONE.
bugs.description: Threaten Hooper with the exact Hut 2 hiding place. The freshly stored straight clue is immediately overwritten with NONE.

bugs.trigger: Try the window, listen at the keyhole, then revisit the door.
bugs.effect: Revisiting the locked door marks the untouched window as smashed.
bugs.description: Try the window, listen at the keyhole, then revisit the door. Revisiting the locked door marks the untouched window as smashed.

bugs.trigger: Inspect enough bunk items to reveal Something else, then take it.
bugs.effect: On the revisit threshold, the selected window-smashing tool is reset.
bugs.description: Inspect enough bunk items to reveal Something else, then take it. On the revisit threshold, the selected window-smashing tool is reset.

bugs.trigger: Take the longer muddy route to Hut 2.
bugs.effect: The irrelevant muddy-shoes flag also creates the component before it is collected.
bugs.description: Take the longer muddy route to Hut 2. The irrelevant muddy-shoes flag also creates the component before it is collected.

bugs.trigger: Choose Leave it after reaching the hidden component.
bugs.effect: The Leave it action puts the component into inventory.
bugs.description: Choose Leave it after reaching the hidden component. The Leave it action puts the component into inventory.

bugs.trigger: Take the muddy route, frame Hooper on the tent, and return without the component.
bugs.effect: The component resurrects only when three unrelated history conditions coincide.
bugs.description: Take the muddy route, frame Hooper on the tent, and return without the component. The component resurrects only when three unrelated history conditions coincide.

bugs.trigger: Return to the room carrying the component and reach morning.
bugs.effect: The Show him the component option is hidden by an inverted condition.
bugs.description: Return to the room carrying the component and reach morning. The Show him the component option is hidden by an inverted condition.
